metaTitle: Custom Midweight Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom midweight pants and shorts for your team. Durable, comfortable workwear with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Midweight pants and shorts offer the ideal balance of durability and comfort for year-round wear. Unlike lightweight options that may wear quickly or heavy-duty styles that trap heat, midweight fabrics like cotton-poly blends provide breathability and resilience. Perfect for field crews, warehouse teams, or outdoor events, these garments hold up to daily use while keeping your team comfortable. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a professional, lasting look.
heroAltText: Custom midweight pants and shorts with embroidered logo, featuring durable cotton-poly blend fabric in khaki and navy colors.
